description: Find issuers where multiple distinct insiders independently bought with their own money (open-market buy: code P, acquisition, not derivative, price above zero, not offset in the same filing by the same shares at the same price) inside a window of transaction dates - a signal raw EDGAR cannot answer. Sorted by total value.

min_distinct_insiders.description: Minimum distinct buyers per issuer, default 2.

min_value_usd.description: Minimum combined buy value per issuer in USD.

window_days.description: Lookback window in days by transaction date, default 30.

name: cluster_buys
title: Cluster buys
